Module.Name: iris-agentic-production
Module.Description: Agentic Production: build, test and govern AI Hub agents in any IRIS interoperability production. An IRIS for Health 2026.3 AI Hub agent triages failed messages and proposes a repair or code mapping; Triage checks it and applies it, asks a person (Workflow) or rejects it. Includes the HL7 lab demo production, the LEGACY demo namespace, a dashboard web app and an eval set.
Module.Keywords: AI Hub agent interoperability HL7 triage governance

Parameter.Name: root
Parameter.Description: Folder that holds kb/, eval/, web/, legacy/ and data/. Empty: /home/irisowner/dev when it holds the repo (Docker), else the copy under the manager directory. Example: zpm "install iris-agentic-production -Droot=/data/agentic/"
